quote: Jazakumullaahu khayran wa Barakallahu feekum. May Allāh Subhanahu wa Ta'ala grant rewards you all thousand folds for this effort. The most thing I love this app is that you can set up your ibadah as a daily goal. And if you couldn't make it all, you always feel guilty thinking that you didn't make ibadah that whole day. The most amazing Islamic app to exist. It keeps track of your finished prayers and you can't just click on the "tick" without praying as Allah is watching. You will feel too guilty to click 'done' without actually praying. Fell in love with this app. It is helping me become a better Muslim. I highly recommend!

Either refund my money, or give me what I had paid for. Shame on you.

I really enjoy using this app every day for my prayers and daily dhikr. The encouragement and progress reminders help me stay motivated and consistent. One feature I'd love to see is the ability to continue Ramadan goals throughout the year and track missed fasting days so we can tick them off as they're completed. Overall, a wonderful app that has become part of my daily routine. JazakAllah Khair!
